title: Fort Wayne TinCaps defeat Lake County, Kasen Wells contributes 1 RBI in MiLB matchup
text:
Former Smithson Valley High School standout Kasen Wells and the Fort Wayne TinCaps captured a 6-2 win over the Lake County Captains in their Minor League Baseball matchup on Tuesday, June 23, at 6:05 p.m.
Classic Auto Group Park hosted the game, marking the 13th faceoff of the season between the two clubs. Entering the matchup, Fort Wayne trailed Lake County 5-8 in their season series.
Wells posted a 1-for-4 line with 1 RBI, earned 1 walk, struck out once, and stranded 3 base runners.
The TinCaps will face the Captains again on Wednesday, June 24, with the contest again taking place at Classic Auto Group Park.
